notes.title: Isekai Spa Simulator "Magical Massage” first PV release! Playtest starts now!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/7056de68b8798f153b0a11b2c2d9069d8a5f5212.png"][/img][/p][p]Ever wondered if hemorrhoids could cause earthquakes? Or if massage could cure them? Or if the treatment might put your life at risk?[/p][p]Hello, players! This is Pop Elephant here![/p][p]The public playtest of Magical Massage is now live on Steam![/p][p]Head over to the game page to request access and be among the first to experience this bizarre and absurd magical massage adventure![/p][p]In the game, you take on the role of a massage therapist who specializes in treating magicians’ most embarrassing conditions—like hemorrhoids that trigger earthquakes or explosive sinusitis. With your divine hands, it’s all up to you to save the day![/p][p]Each client will also start rambling nonsense under your hypnosis (uh... maybe this is the perfect time to upsell them on a VIP membership^^)[/p][p]Currently, Magical Massage is still in early development, and some parts are being refined. If you encounter any bugs or have eager feedback and suggestions while playing, feel free to join our official QQ group 1046610890. Who knows—your brilliant ideas might make it into the final version of the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/07374dcd78b8b7c6809311928179e20eb9a05de8.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve worked hard to improve the game based on feedback from the first test! In this round, several new massageable characters have been added, and we hope they bring you a fresh experience![/p]

notes.title: ⚡ Satisfy your client, or die on the spot! playtest is ready!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/f876fdc2f6891b21573a05f961db0dd3ab092f79.gif[/img]
[b]Earthquake-level hemorrhoids, flood-like night sweats, fire-breathing rhinitis...[/b]  

Powerful mages unbutton their shirts and unzip their zippers, bringing their [b]unspeakable troubles[/b] to you. Your job—make their bodies feel [b]relieved[/b].  

But if your technique is off... their reactions could be even deadlier than their conditions.  

[b]💥 Click “Request Access” to start playing! The test will end in February.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/1ae48c7ad352bcb6e072e7ca5f0d8eacbaeb9b37.png[/img]  
[b]💆 Your Tasks[/b]  
[list]  
[*][b]Massage Treatment[/b] – Choose the right position and pressure, don’t press your life away.  
[*][b]Market Stocking[/b] – Carefully purchase essential oils and aromatic substances, or risk closing your shop.  
[*][b]Survival Socializing[/b] – Explore the world, maintain client relationships, and uncover the dark side of the world.  
[/list]  
[b]🤝 Playtest Clients Overview[/b]  
[list]  
[*][b]🥀 Erectile Dysfunction[/b]  
Juste, the youngest president of the Magician's Association, is powerful but has been criticized by women for his "impotence." Saving his family's honor relies entirely on your hands!  
[*][b]🌸 Shoulder Inflammation[/b]  
Katya, your childhood friend, has been saving up to buy her deceased sister's leg at an auction. But now she has shoulder pain, and strange flower buds are appearing on her skin...  
[*][b]🎤 Throat Inflammation[/b]  
Lucy, the kingdom’s top diva, has ruined her voice from constant performances, with bruises and smoke scars hinting at deeper injuries. Can she still sing?  
[*][b]🐉 Rhinitis[/b]  
Zhu Rengong, a self-proclaimed "high school senior time-traveler," sneezes fire and has been hired to investigate the most terrifying attack in history. Still dreaming of a harem... will he survive?  
[*][b]💦 Night Sweats[/b]  
Scyll, a nun, tormented by the pain and insults of her patients, faces homelessness due to uncontrollable night sweats. Her request for help is... unexpected...  
[/list]  
[b]💥 A little flirting may enhance the mood, but smashing people's sensitive areas may get you killed. Extreme life-and-death massages, whether heaven or hell, it all depends on your skills!💥[/b]  
[b]⚠️ Warning: This game currently does not support English.[/b]

However, feel free to add it to your wishlist to help boost the game's visibility and localization efforts! We’re working hard to bring more language options in the future, and your support makes a big difference. Thank you!
